description: Waveshaper VCO: a sine oscillator with linear FM, driven through a folder and clipper into ten Chebyshev waveshapers, which gives a level control and a CV input for each of the first ten harmonics

params.text: Tunes the sine oscillator a semitone up or down
Sets the base octave of the sine oscillator over a ten octave range, with the octave number shown above the knob
Drives the folder or clipper harder, and combines with the Gain CV and the EG input; the waveshapers give exact harmonics only at a gain of exactly 1, which the Preset button restores
Attenuates the CV at the Mod jack, which bends the pitch exponentially and gives inharmonic timbres at audio rates
Sets the depth of through-zero linear FM from the signal at the LFM jack, which keeps the harmonics in tune as the depth changes
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Gain jack before it is combined with the Gain knob
Picks what the stage in front of the waveshapers does with a signal over one volt: Fold runs it through a wave folder, Clip hard-clips it
Rolls off the upper harmonics, 18dB per octave fully counter-clockwise and flat fully clockwise
Scales all the even harmonics together, leaving the fundamental alone, and passes the individual harmonic levels untouched when fully up
Scales all the odd harmonics together, leaving the fundamental alone, and passes the individual harmonic levels untouched when fully up
Sets the level of that waveshaper's harmonic in the output mix
Sets the rise time of the lag generators on all ten harmonic level CV inputs, which are exponential and share this setting
Sets the fall time of the lag generators on all ten harmonic level CV inputs, which are exponential and share this setting
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Even jack before it is added to the Even knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Odd jack before it is added to the Odd knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Slope jack before it is added to the Slope knob
Transposes the sine oscillator by up to 11 semitones either way, with the note name shown above the knob

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the sine oscillator, a volt per octave
Bends the pitch exponentially through the Mod knob
The modulator input for through-zero linear FM, its depth set by the LFM knob
Combines with the Gain knob to drive the folder or clipper, so a 0-10V envelope here sweeps the timbre from dull to bright
Drives the gain of the stage feeding the waveshapers, through the trim knob below the Gain control; an envelope patched here shifts the timbre rather than the output level
Replaces the internal sine oscillator as the source fed to the folder, clipper and waveshapers; precise harmonic control needs the internal oscillator instead
Rolls off the upper harmonics through the Slope trim knob
Sets the level of that harmonic through the lag generator set by the Rise and Fall knobs, multiplying with the knob beside it
Lengthens the rise time of the lag generators on the harmonic level inputs, added to the Rise knob
Lengthens the fall time of the lag generators on the harmonic level inputs, added to the Fall knob
Scales all the even harmonics through the Even trim knob
Scales all the odd harmonics through the Odd trim knob

notes: the Preset button steps between the fundamental alone, all ten harmonics up, and your own earlier setting, and always resets the gain to exactly 1, which is what precise harmonics need
the clip lamp is green while there is signal and red while the folder or clipper is working
the Mod, LFM, Gain, Even, Odd and Slope trim knobs come up at zero, so a cable at any of those modulation inputs changes nothing until its trim is turned off centre
there is no volume envelope in the module; an envelope patched to EG shifts the timbre, and a volume envelope needs a VCA after the output

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
